Name: Clinging Slime
Components: V, S, M (a vial of babau blood worth at least 100 gp)
Description:
Your flesh and equipment begin to weep hot red tears that quickly coat your body and equipment in a slimy layer of red jelly.

For the duration, a creature that touches you or hits you with a melee attack while within 5 feet of you takes 3d6 acid damage.

Additionally, a creature that you are grappling, that is grappling you, or that has swallowed you must succeed on a Constitution saving throw or take 2d6 acid damage at the start of its turn.
At Higher Levels: When you cast this spell using a spell slot of 4th level or higher, the damage of each of its effects increases by 1d6 for each slot level above 3rd.
